pgw_interfaces_cp_if.description: Network interface (e.g., eth0) used for PGW control plane (GTP-C) traffic.

pgw_interfaces_cp_address.description: IPv4 address assigned to the control plane interface.

pgw_interfaces_cp_ipv6_address.description: Optional IPv6 address for control plane (leave empty if not used).

pgw_interfaces_up_if.description: Network interface used for user plane (GTP-U) traffic.

pgw_interfaces_up_address.description: IPv4 address assigned to the user plane interface.

pgw_interfaces_up_ipv6_address.description: Optional IPv6 address for user plane (leave empty if not used).

pgw_interfaces_gx_if.description: Optional interface for Gx (PCRF) Diameter connection (e.g., eth2).

pgw_interfaces_gx_address.description: IPv4 address of the Gx interface (required if Gx enabled).

pgw_interfaces_gy_if.description: Optional interface for Gy (AAAR) Diameter connection.

pgw_interfaces_gy_address.description: IPv4 address of the Gy interface (required if Gy enabled).

pgw_log_level.description: Log verbosity level. Use DEBUG for troubleshooting.

pgw_log_file.description: Path to PGW log file, or 'stdout' to log to console.

pgw_identity_fqdn.description: Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) of the PGW used in Diameter messages.

pgw_identity_realm.description: Diameter realm of the PGW (typically same as MNC/MCC domain).

qci.description: QoS Class Identifier (QCI) — e.g., 1 for voice, 9 for best effort.

priority_level.description: Allocation and Retention Priority (ARP) priority level (1–15, lower = higher priority).

preemption_cap.description: Can this bearer be preempted by higher-priority bearers?

preemption_vuln.description: Can this bearer preempt lower-priority bearers?

ipv4.description: IPv4 subnet (CIDR) from which UE IPs are allocated for this APN.

ipv6_prefix.description: Optional IPv6 prefix (e.g., '2001:db8:abcd::/48') for UE IPv6 assignment.

primary.description: Primary DNS server for this APN.

secondary.description: Secondary DNS server for this APN.

mtu.description: Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) for this APN.

pgw_apn_list.description: List of supported APNs, each defining QoS, UE address pool, DNS, and MTU.

fqdn.description: FQDN of the peer MME/SGW (used for Diameter routing).

address.description: IPv4 address of the peer MME/SGW.

ipv6_address.description: Optional IPv6 address of the peer.

pgw_mme_peers.description: List of MME/SGW peers for S5/S8 connectivity (e.g., in multi-MME deployments).

pgw_charging_gx_enabled.description: Enable Gx interface to PCRF for policy and charging control.

pgw_charging_gx_destination_realm.description: Diameter realm of the PCRF (required if Gx enabled).

pgw_charging_gy_enabled.description: Enable Gy interface to AAAR for online charging (e.g., for prepaid subscribers).

pgw_charging_gy_destination_realm.description: Diameter realm of the AAAR (required if Gy enabled).

pgw_limits_max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent PDN connections (sessions) the PGW can handle.

pgw_limits_max_bearers_per_ue.description: Maximum number of bearer connections allowed per UE (standard: 11, includes default bearer).

pgw_limits_gtpu_echo_interval.description: Interval (seconds) for GTP-U echo requests; set to 0 to disable echo.
